title: ESP32-S2-DevKitC-1
notes: Not broken out: GPIO26-32 (SPI flash and PSRAM); all other GPIOs (GPIO0-21, GPIO33-46) are on J1/J3.
GPIO0, GPIO45 and GPIO46 are strapping pins; GPIO46 is input only with a fixed pull-down.
GPIO18 drives the on-board RGB LED and is not pulled up on boards with an ESP32-S2-SOLO-2 or -SOLO-2U module.
TX/RX (GPIO43/GPIO44) are U0TXD/U0RXD on the USB-to-UART bridge.
GPIO19/GPIO20 are USB_D-/USB_D+ of the ESP32-S2 USB OTG port (J3-20/J3-19).
GPIO39-42 carry the JTAG pads (MTCK, MTDO, MTDI, MTMS), usually used for inline debug.

Standard module: ESP32-S2-SOLO-2 (ESP32-S2-DevKitC-1-N8R2: 8 MB flash, 2 MB PSRAM). The ordering table also lists ESP32-S2-DevKitC-1U-N8R2 (ESP32-S2-SOLO-2U, external antenna connector); ESP32-S2-DevKitC-1R and -1RU (ESP32-S2-SOLO/-SOLO-U, 4 MB flash) are EOL.
Power the board one way only: the USB ports, or the 5V and G pins, or the 3V3 and G pins (the guide calls them mutually exclusive).
The other Espressif ESP32-S2 boards ESP32-S2-DevKitM-1 and ESP32-S2-Saola-1 are on Espressif's EOL list.
J1 is drawn on the left and J3 on the right (USB at the bottom) as on the other Espressif DevKits; the guide's pin layout figure is not in the pinned corpus, so the side is unverified.
